title: Conflict Resolution
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office navigates various conflicts through discussions, mediations, and humorous exchanges. Michael introduces conflict resolution styles and attempts to mediate disputes, including a poster disagreement and employee tensions. Dwight confronts Michael about his dissatisfaction, threatening to leave unless Jim is transferred. Pam and Angela have a tense interaction over wedding plans, and the episode concludes with the office resolving some conflicts and taking group photos, though some outcomes remain uncertain.
